title: Iconic REMAX Balloon Enters Next Chapter, Takes Flight This October
summary: A refreshed balloon design makes its debut at the 2026 Balloon Fiesta this fall, continuing a nearly five-decade tradition of elevating the REMAX brand ‘Above the Crowd!.'
body_markdown:
The countdown is on.


In early October, thousands of spectators will look skyward as hundreds of colorful hot air balloons rise above the horizon at the Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta, one of the world’s largest ballooning events. Among them will be a familiar sight: the iconic red, white and blue REMAX hot air balloon.


Between October 2-4, REMAX will unveil a newly designed balloon envelope featuring the brand’s refreshed logo, offering attendees one of the first glimpses at the new look before it takes flight at events across North America.


The debut marks another milestone in the evolution of a symbol that has represented the REMAX network for nearly five decades.


**From Bold Idea to Global Symbol**


The story of the REMAX balloon began in 1978, when New Mexico franchise owners proposed using a hot air balloon to promote the 5-year-old real estate brand. Within a year, the balloon became the network’s official logo.


The timing proved transformative.


As REMAX expanded across North America and around the world, the balloon became the visual embodiment of the network’s “Above the Crowd!” philosophy. Today, it remains one of the most recognizable symbols in real estate and one of the most enduring elements of the REMAX brand.


**From Marketing Tool to Community Magnet**


What began as a creative marketing idea quickly evolved into something much bigger.


Over the years, the REMAX balloon fleet grew into one of the largest corporate balloon fleets in the world, appearing at festivals, charitable events, school programs, grand openings and community celebrations across North America and beyond.


For REMAX affiliates, the balloon became more than a logo brought to life. It became a powerful way to connect with consumers outside of a transaction, creating memorable moments that keep the REMAX brand top of mind long before someone is ready to buy or sell a home.


“Consumers may not know your brand when they’re not actively buying or selling a home,” says Abby Lee, Real REMAX Group Chief Marketing Officer. “That’s where the REMAX balloon stands apart. People see it and instantly think about the REMAX agents in their community. It bridges the gap between affiliates and consumers, giving a real estate company instant recognition.”


Over the years, the REMAX brand has evolved through multiple visual updates while maintaining the elements that make it instantly recognizable.


**From Fresh Design to Lasting Impact**


That consistency is exactly what makes this latest unveiling meaningful.


“When you have a symbol that powerful, you continue to invest in it, strengthen it and keep it looking modern and relevant,” Lee says.


The updated envelope reflects that philosophy. While the design introduces a fresh look aligned with today’s REMAX brand, it remains rooted in the same qualities that have defined the balloon since its first flight nearly 50 years ago: visibility, professionalism and a commitment to standing above the crowd.


When the refreshed REMAX balloon takes flight in Albuquerque this October, attendees will see the latest chapter of an icon that has been elevating the REMAX brand and capturing consumers’ attention since it first rose over New Mexico’s skies more than 50 years ago.
